courses.name: 今天我心情特别好
courses.description: 学会表达情绪与近况，掌握 3 个高频口语表达，能在日常寒暄中自然回应。

lessons.name: 1-1 说出我的好心情
lessons.scene: 早上在咖啡店遇到同事 Lily，她问你今天怎么样。
lessons.target_sentence: I'm in a really good mood today.

knowledge_points.title: in a good mood
knowledge_points.explanation: 表示心情好，比 I'm happy 更口语、更自然，日常寒暄常用。
knowledge_points.example: I'm in a great mood this morning.

knowledge_points.title: really 的强调作用
knowledge_points.explanation: 放在形容词前加强语气，相当于「真的、特别」，比 very 更口语。
knowledge_points.example: That sounds really nice.

exercises.question: 你想说「我今天心情特别好」，用刚学的表达怎么说？
exercises.reference_answer: I'm in a really good mood today.

roleplay.setting: 早上在咖啡店，Lily 看你心情不错，主动搭话。
roleplay.opening_line: Hey! You look happy today. What's going on?
roleplay.goal: 用至少 1 句话说明你的好心情

lessons.name: 2-1 说出让我开心的原因
lessons.scene: Lily 追问你为什么这么开心，你想告诉她你找到了新工作。
lessons.target_sentence: I just got a new job, so I'm really excited.

knowledge_points.title: just + 过去式
knowledge_points.explanation: 表示「刚刚、才」，强调事情刚发生，常和过去式搭配。
knowledge_points.example: I just finished my project.

knowledge_points.title: so 连接因果关系
knowledge_points.explanation: so 引出结果，比 because 更轻快，口语里非常常见。
knowledge_points.example: It was raining, so I stayed home.

exercises.question: 你想说「我刚找到新工作，所以特别兴奋」，用刚学的结构怎么说？
exercises.reference_answer: I just got a new job, so I'm really excited.

roleplay.setting: Lily 很感兴趣，继续追问细节。
roleplay.opening_line: Wow, that's great news! What kind of job is it?
roleplay.goal: 介绍新工作的至少一个细节，并表达期待

lessons.name: 3-1 反问对方，让对话继续
lessons.scene: 聊完自己的近况，你不想让对话冷场，想把话题抛回给 Lily。
lessons.target_sentence: Thanks for asking! How about you?

knowledge_points.title: Thanks for asking
knowledge_points.explanation: 表达感谢对方关心，是英美人结束自我陈述时的礼貌过渡句。
knowledge_points.example: Thanks for asking! I've been pretty busy.

knowledge_points.title: How about you?
knowledge_points.explanation: 把话题抛回对方，避免对话变成单向独白。
knowledge_points.example: I'm doing well. How about you?

exercises.question: 说完自己的近况后，你想感谢对方并反问，怎么说？
exercises.reference_answer: Thanks for asking! How about you?

roleplay.setting: 你想把话题交回给 Lily，练习自然收尾。
roleplay.opening_line: It sounds like a big change for you. Anything else new?
roleplay.goal: 用感谢 + 反问结束自己部分，并让对方开始说

courses.name: 餐厅点餐实用英语
courses.description: 从进店入座到点餐结账，掌握 3 个餐厅高频场景句型，出国吃饭不再尴尬。

chapters.name: 第一章 · 入座与点单

lessons.name: 1-1 我想点一份牛排
lessons.scene: 你在伦敦一家西餐厅，服务员递上菜单后询问你想点什么。
lessons.target_sentence: I'd like to order the steak, medium rare, please.

knowledge_points.title: I'd like to order
knowledge_points.explanation: 「我想点…」，比 I want 更礼貌，是餐厅点单的标准句型。
knowledge_points.example: I'd like to order the fish and chips.

knowledge_points.title: medium rare
knowledge_points.explanation: 牛排熟度：三分熟。常见还有 rare（一分）、medium（五分）、well done（全熟）。
knowledge_points.example: I'll have the steak, medium, please.

exercises.question: 你想点一份五分熟的牛排，怎么说？
exercises.reference_answer: I'd like to order the steak, medium, please.

roleplay.setting: 你拿着菜单，服务员走过来准备为你点单。
roleplay.opening_line: Good evening! Are you ready to order?
roleplay.goal: 礼貌地点一份主菜，并说明熟度或偏好

lessons.name: 2-1 我不吃辣
lessons.scene: 你在曼谷一家餐厅，想点一道菜但不吃辣，需要向服务员说明。
lessons.target_sentence: Could you make it without chili, please? I'm not used to spicy food.

knowledge_points.title: Could you make it without...
knowledge_points.explanation: 「能不能不放…」，委婉提出食材修改要求，比直接说 Don't put 更得体。
knowledge_points.example: Could you make it without onions, please?

knowledge_points.title: be not used to
knowledge_points.explanation: 「不习惯…」，解释自己的饮食习惯，让对方理解你的要求。
knowledge_points.example: I'm not used to eating cold food in the morning.

exercises.question: 你想让厨师不放洋葱，并说自己不习惯吃洋葱，怎么说？
exercises.reference_answer: Could you make it without onions, please? I'm not used to onions.

roleplay.setting: 点单时服务员确认菜品，你需要提出特殊要求。
roleplay.opening_line: So that's one green curry. Anything else?
roleplay.goal: 说明不吃辣/某种食材的要求，并确认对方理解

lessons.name: 3-1 请结账
lessons.scene: 用餐结束，你想结账离开，需要叫服务员并说明支付方式。
lessons.target_sentence: Excuse me, could we have the check, please? I'll pay by card.

knowledge_points.title: have the check / bill
knowledge_points.explanation: 「买单」。美式英语说 check，英式说 bill，两者都通用。
knowledge_points.example: Could we get the check, please?

knowledge_points.title: pay by card
knowledge_points.explanation: 「刷卡支付」。还可说 pay in cash（现金）、pay by phone（手机支付）。
knowledge_points.example: I'd like to pay by card if that's possible.

exercises.question: 你想叫服务员结账并用现金支付，怎么说？
exercises.reference_answer: Excuse me, could we have the check, please? I'll pay in cash.

roleplay.setting: 用餐接近尾声，你举手示意服务员。
roleplay.opening_line: Was everything to your liking tonight?
roleplay.goal: 表达满意并请求结账，说明支付方式

courses.name: 出国旅行必备口语
courses.description: 覆盖机场、酒店、问路三大旅行场景，掌握 3 个应急高频句型。

lessons.name: 1-1 我来旅游的
lessons.scene: 洛杉矶机场入关，海关官员问你来美国的目的。
lessons.target_sentence: I'm here for tourism. I'll be staying for two weeks.

knowledge_points.title: I'm here for + 目的
knowledge_points.explanation: 「我来这儿是为了…」，入关回答目的的标准句型，后接 tourism / business / study。
knowledge_points.example: I'm here for a business meeting.

knowledge_points.title: I'll be staying for + 时长
knowledge_points.explanation: 「我将停留…」，说明停留时长，入关高频回答。
knowledge_points.example: I'll be staying for ten days.

exercises.question: 你来说出差，停留一周，怎么回答海关？
exercises.reference_answer: I'm here for business. I'll be staying for one week.

roleplay.setting: 入关柜台，官员查看你的护照并提问。
roleplay.opening_line: Good afternoon. What's the purpose of your visit?
roleplay.goal: 说明来访目的和停留时长，语气清晰简洁

lessons.name: 2-1 我有预订
lessons.scene: 你到达巴黎一家酒店前台，办理入住手续。
lessons.target_sentence: Hi, I have a reservation under the name Li Ming.

knowledge_points.title: have a reservation
knowledge_points.explanation: 「有预订」，酒店入住第一句话，也可说 have a booking。
knowledge_points.example: I have a reservation for three nights.

knowledge_points.title: under the name
knowledge_points.explanation: 「以…的名义」，说明预订时用的名字，前台查找订单的关键信息。
knowledge_points.example: The reservation is under my wife's name.

exercises.question: 你以 Wang Wei 的名字预订了房间，怎么跟前台说？
exercises.reference_answer: Hi, I have a reservation under the name Wang Wei.

roleplay.setting: 你拖着行李走到前台，前台微笑示意。
roleplay.opening_line: Welcome! How may I help you today?
roleplay.goal: 说明有预订并报出预订人姓名，配合办理入住

lessons.name: 3-1 请问地铁站在哪
lessons.scene: 你在东京街头迷路，想找最近的地铁站，向路人求助。
lessons.target_sentence: Excuse me, could you tell me how to get to the nearest subway station?

knowledge_points.title: Could you tell me how to get to...
knowledge_points.explanation: 「请问怎么去…」，问路最礼貌的万能句型，比 Where is 更自然。
knowledge_points.example: Could you tell me how to get to the museum?

knowledge_points.title: nearest
knowledge_points.explanation: 「最近的」，near 的最高级，问路时常加在地点前限定范围。
knowledge_points.example: Where's the nearest bus stop?

exercises.question: 你想问最近的洗手间在哪，怎么说？
exercises.reference_answer: Excuse me, could you tell me how to get to the nearest restroom?

roleplay.setting: 你在街角拦住一位看起来友善的路人。
roleplay.opening_line: Yes? Can I help you with something?
roleplay.goal: 礼貌地问路，并根据对方回答确认方向

courses.name: 雅思口语 Part 1-3 核心表达
courses.description: 覆盖雅思口语三部分：Part 1 开场问答、Part 2 话题卡展开、Part 3 深度讨论，掌握 3 个拿分句型。

lessons.name: 1-1 回答住址问题
lessons.scene: 雅思口语考官开场问你住在哪，你想给出完整又自然的回答。
lessons.target_sentence: I live in a small apartment downtown with my family.

knowledge_points.title: downtown
knowledge_points.explanation: 副词，指「在市中心」，放在地点后补充说明，比 in the city center 更地道。
knowledge_points.example: She works downtown but lives in the suburbs.

knowledge_points.title: with + 人
knowledge_points.explanation: 说明同住关系，让回答从单句扩展成有细节的完整句，Part 1 加分项。
knowledge_points.example: I moved here with my roommate last year.

exercises.question: 考官问你住在哪，你想说「我和室友住在市中心的小公寓」，怎么说？
exercises.reference_answer: I live in a small apartment downtown with my roommate.

roleplay.setting: Part 1 开场，考官询问考生基本信息。
roleplay.opening_line: Good morning. Can you tell me where you live?
roleplay.goal: 用完整句回答住址，并补充一个同住或周边环境的细节

chapters.name: 第二章 · Part 2 话题卡

lessons.name: 2-1 话题卡开头
lessons.scene: 考官给你一张话题卡：「描述一件让你骄傲的事」，你需要在 1 分钟内开口。
lessons.target_sentence: One thing I'm really proud of is finishing my first marathon last year.

knowledge_points.title: be proud of
knowledge_points.explanation: 「为…感到骄傲」，Part 2 描述成就类话题的高频词组，注意后接名词或动名词。
knowledge_points.example: I'm proud of my brother for getting into medical school.

knowledge_points.title: One thing (that) ... is
knowledge_points.explanation: Part 2 万能开头句型，把抽象话题落地成具体事件，避免开头卡壳。
knowledge_points.example: One thing that really impressed me was the view from the top.

exercises.question: 话题卡要求描述「一件让你骄傲的事」，你想说「让我最骄傲的事是去年跑完了第一个马拉松」，怎么说？
exercises.reference_answer: One thing I'm really proud of is finishing my first marathon last year.

roleplay.setting: Part 2，考官递上话题卡，考生有 1 分钟准备时间。
roleplay.opening_line: Here is your topic. You have one minute to prepare, then speak for up to two minutes.
roleplay.goal: 用 One thing I'm proud of 开头，展开 2-3 句具体细节

chapters.name: 第三章 · Part 3 深度讨论

lessons.name: 3-1 表达观点与原因
lessons.scene: Part 3 考官追问：「为什么现代人更愿意花钱旅游？」你需要先给观点再解释原因。
lessons.target_sentence: I think it's mainly because people have more disposable income now.

knowledge_points.title: mainly because
knowledge_points.explanation: 「主要是因为」，Part 3 给原因的标准开头，比 just because 更正式、更有论证感。
knowledge_points.example: Prices are rising, mainly because of inflation.

knowledge_points.title: disposable income
knowledge_points.explanation: 「可支配收入」，Part 3 讨论消费、生活方式类话题的加分词汇。
knowledge_points.example: Families have more disposable income to spend on leisure.

exercises.question: 你想说「我觉得主要是因为现在人们的可支配收入更多了」，怎么说？
exercises.reference_answer: I think it's mainly because people have more disposable income now.

roleplay.setting: Part 3，考官就 Part 2 话题延伸出抽象问题。
roleplay.opening_line: Why do you think more people are choosing to travel abroad these days?
roleplay.goal: 先给明确观点，再用 mainly because 解释，给出一个具体论据

courses.name: 雅思写作 Task 1 & 2 高分句型
courses.description: 覆盖 Task 1 图表描述与 Task 2 议论文开头，掌握 3 个写作核心句型，让开头不再模板化。

chapters.name: 第一章 · Task 1 图表概述

lessons.name: 1-1 描述总体趋势
lessons.scene: Task 1 给你一张折线图，显示过去十年城市人口变化，你需要写一句概述。
lessons.target_sentence: Overall, the population of the city increased significantly over the period.

knowledge_points.title: Overall
knowledge_points.explanation: 「总体来看」，Task 1 overview 段的标准开头词，考官一眼识别概述结构。
knowledge_points.example: Overall, sales remained stable throughout the year.

knowledge_points.title: increased significantly
knowledge_points.explanation: 「显著增长」。significantly 比 greatly/quickly 更正式，写作加分副词。
knowledge_points.example: The number of students increased significantly after 2015.

exercises.question: 你想概述「总体来说，失业率在这段时间显著下降」，怎么写？
exercises.reference_answer: Overall, the unemployment rate decreased significantly over the period.

roleplay.setting: 老师在批改你的 Task 1，问你概述句想写什么。
roleplay.opening_line: Let's start with the overview. What's the main trend in this chart?
roleplay.goal: 用 Overall 开头，用一个副词描述趋势方向和幅度

chapters.name: 第二章 · Task 1 数据对比

lessons.name: 2-1 用 while 对比数据
lessons.scene: 图表显示 A 国进口增长而 B 国进口下降，你需要用一句话对比。
lessons.target_sentence: While imports in Country A rose, those in Country B fell sharply.

knowledge_points.title: While 引导对比
knowledge_points.explanation: 「而…」，连接两个相反趋势的分句，是 Task 1 对比数据的高分连接词。
knowledge_points.example: While men preferred sports, women favored reading.

knowledge_points.title: those 替代复数名词
knowledge_points.explanation: 用 those 代替前面出现过的复数名词（imports），避免重复，体现衔接能力。
knowledge_points.example: The prices in 2020 were higher than those in 2010.

exercises.question: 你想写「城市 A 的房价上涨，而城市 B 的下跌」，怎么用 while 表达？
exercises.reference_answer: While house prices in City A rose, those in City B fell.

roleplay.setting: 老师让你用一句话对比图中的两组数据。
roleplay.opening_line: Now show me the contrast between the two groups in one sentence.
roleplay.goal: 用 while 连接两个相反趋势，并用 those 避免重复

chapters.name: 第三章 · Task 2 开头表态

lessons.name: 3-1 明确表达立场
lessons.scene: Task 2 题目：「政府是否应该资助艺术？」你需要在开头段明确表态。
lessons.target_sentence: In my opinion, governments should continue to fund the arts for several reasons.

knowledge_points.title: In my opinion
knowledge_points.explanation: 「在我看来」，Task 2 开头表态的标准短语，比 I think 更正式。
knowledge_points.example: In my opinion, this policy will benefit society.

knowledge_points.title: for several reasons
knowledge_points.explanation: 「出于几个原因」，放在开头段末尾预告下文结构，让考官知道你会展开论证。
knowledge_points.example: I disagree with this view for several reasons.

exercises.question: 你不同意「大学生必须住校」这个观点，想在开头表态，怎么写？
exercises.reference_answer: In my opinion, university students should not be required to live on campus for several reasons.

roleplay.setting: 老师问你对这道作文题的立场是什么。
roleplay.opening_line: What's your position on this topic? State it clearly in your thesis.
roleplay.goal: 用 In my opinion 明确表态，并用 for several reasons 预告结构

courses.name: 雅思听力高频场景
courses.description: 覆盖雅思听力 Section 1-2 高频场景：租房咨询、图书馆登记、活动报名，掌握 3 个抓取关键信息的句型。

lessons.name: 1-1 询问租金与押金
lessons.scene: 听力 Section 1：学生打电话给中介咨询一套公寓的租金。
lessons.target_sentence: Could you tell me how much the rent is, and whether a deposit is required?

knowledge_points.title: how much the rent is
knowledge_points.explanation: 租金多少。注意宾语从句用陈述语序，Section 1 填空题常考 rent 数字。
knowledge_points.example: Could you tell me how much the rent is per month?

knowledge_points.title: whether a deposit is required
knowledge_points.explanation: 「是否需要押金」。whether 引导的宾语从句，比 if 更正式。
knowledge_points.example: I'd like to know whether a deposit is required.

exercises.question: 你想问租金多少以及是否包含水电费，怎么说？
exercises.reference_answer: Could you tell me how much the rent is, and whether utilities are included?

roleplay.setting: 学生在电话里咨询租房信息，中介逐一回答。
roleplay.opening_line: Thanks for calling Sunshine Rentals. How can I help you?
roleplay.goal: 询问租金和押金，注意抓取数字信息

chapters.name: 第二章 · 图书馆登记

lessons.name: 2-1 办理借书证
lessons.scene: 听力 Section 1：新生到图书馆办理借书证，工作人员询问个人信息。
lessons.target_sentence: I'd like to apply for a library card. What documents do I need to bring?

knowledge_points.title: apply for
knowledge_points.explanation: 「申请…」，图书馆、签证、工作场景高频短语，注意 for 后接名词。
knowledge_points.example: I want to apply for a student visa.

knowledge_points.title: documents
knowledge_points.explanation: 「文件、证件」的复数，比 papers 更正式，办理手续时常用。
knowledge_points.example: Please bring two forms of identification documents.

exercises.question: 你想申请借书证并问需要带什么证件，怎么说？
exercises.reference_answer: I'd like to apply for a library card. What documents do I need to bring?

roleplay.setting: 新生走到图书馆服务台，说明来意。
roleplay.opening_line: Hello, welcome to the library. What can I do for you?
roleplay.goal: 说明要办借书证，并询问所需证件

lessons.name: 3-1 确认时间与费用
lessons.scene: 听力 Section 2：社区中心工作人员介绍瑜伽课，你打电话报名并确认细节。
lessons.target_sentence: I'd like to sign up for the yoga class. When does it start and how much does it cost?

knowledge_points.title: sign up for
knowledge_points.explanation: 「报名参加…」，活动、课程、会员场景高频短语，Section 2 常考。
knowledge_points.example: I want to sign up for the photography course.

knowledge_points.title: how much does it cost
knowledge_points.explanation: 「多少钱」，特殊疑问句语序，听力中常作为问句信号提示后面有数字答案。
knowledge_points.example: How much does the membership cost per year?

exercises.question: 你想报名游泳课并问开始时间和费用，怎么说？
exercises.reference_answer: I'd like to sign up for the swimming class. When does it start and how much does it cost?

roleplay.setting: 你打电话到社区中心，想报名一门课程。
roleplay.opening_line: Greenfield Community Center, how may I help you?
roleplay.goal: 说明要报名的课程，并确认时间和费用

courses.name: 托福听力核心表达
courses.description: 覆盖托福听力三大场景：校园对话、学术讲座、推断态度，掌握 3 个理解与复述关键句型。

lessons.name: 1-1 图书馆找书
lessons.scene: 托福听力校园对话场景：学生去图书馆找一本有机化学教材却找不到。
lessons.target_sentence: I'm looking for a book on organic chemistry, but I can't find it anywhere.

knowledge_points.title: look for
knowledge_points.explanation: 「寻找」，强调过程而非结果（find 强调结果），校园对话高频短语。
knowledge_points.example: I've been looking for my notes all morning.

knowledge_points.title: on + 学科
knowledge_points.explanation: 表示「关于某学科的」，on 比 about 更正式，常用于书名、课程名前。
knowledge_points.example: She's writing a paper on climate change.

exercises.question: 你想跟图书管理员说「我在找一本关于有机化学的书，但哪儿都找不到」，怎么说？
exercises.reference_answer: I'm looking for a book on organic chemistry, but I can't find it anywhere.

roleplay.setting: 学生在前台求助，管理员帮忙查询馆藏系统。
roleplay.opening_line: Hi there, how can I help you today?
roleplay.goal: 说明要找的书和学科，并配合管理员的追问

lessons.name: 2-1 教授定义术语
lessons.scene: 托福听力学术讲座：生物学教授在课上定义「光合作用」。
lessons.target_sentence: What we call photosynthesis is the process by which plants convert sunlight into energy.

knowledge_points.title: What we call X is
knowledge_points.explanation: 「我们所说的 X 就是…」，教授下定义的经典句型，托福讲座术语题必考信号。
knowledge_points.example: What we call gravity is the force pulling objects toward the earth.

knowledge_points.title: convert A into B
knowledge_points.explanation: 「把 A 转化为 B」，物理、化学、生物讲座高频搭配。
knowledge_points.example: The engine converts fuel into mechanical power.

exercises.question: 教授想定义「光合作用」，想说「我们所说的光合作用就是植物把阳光转化为能量的过程」，怎么说？
exercises.reference_answer: What we call photosynthesis is the process by which plants convert sunlight into energy.

roleplay.setting: 课堂提问环节，学生请教授再解释一遍定义。
roleplay.opening_line: So, let's make sure everyone understands this key term. What did I say photosynthesis is?
roleplay.goal: 用 What we call 句型复述定义，并解释 convert 的含义

lessons.name: 3-1 听懂隐含态度
lessons.scene: 托福听力态度题：教授对某种研究方法保留意见，用委婉语气表达问题。
lessons.target_sentence: Now, this approach isn't without its problems, as you can imagine.

knowledge_points.title: not without its problems
knowledge_points.explanation: 双重否定表「并非没有问题」，是教授委婉批评的典型表达，态度题必抓信号。
knowledge_points.example: The theory isn't without its critics.

knowledge_points.title: as you can imagine
knowledge_points.explanation: 「你可以想象」，插入语，暗示接下来要说的是显而易见的问题，引导听众跟随。
knowledge_points.example: The exam was very long, as you can imagine.

exercises.question: 教授想委婉指出「这种方法并非没有问题」，怎么说？
exercises.reference_answer: Now, this approach isn't without its problems, as you can imagine.

roleplay.setting: 教授在讲完一种研究方法后，引导学生讨论其局限性。
roleplay.opening_line: So we've seen how this method works in theory. But in practice...?
roleplay.goal: 识别教授的保留态度，用 not without 句型复述其隐含批评

courses.name: 托福口语 Task 1-4 答题框架
courses.description: 覆盖托福口语独立题与综合题，掌握 3 个答题开头与展开句型，让回答结构清晰。

chapters.name: 第一章 · Task 1 独立题

lessons.name: 1-1 表达偏好并给理由
lessons.scene: Task 1 题目：「你喜欢住大城市还是小城镇？」你需要先表态再给理由。
lessons.target_sentence: I prefer living in a big city because there are more job opportunities there.

knowledge_points.title: I prefer + 动名词
knowledge_points.explanation: 「我更喜欢…」，Task 1 表态首选句型，后接动名词（doing）。
knowledge_points.example: I prefer studying in the morning.

knowledge_points.title: because there are more
knowledge_points.explanation: 「因为有更多…」，给出具体理由的开头，让回答不空泛。
knowledge_points.example: I prefer online classes because there are more flexible schedules.

exercises.question: 你更喜欢纸质书，理由是阅读体验更好，怎么回答？
exercises.reference_answer: I prefer reading paper books because they offer a better reading experience.

roleplay.setting: Task 1 准备 15 秒后开始作答。
roleplay.opening_line: Please speak now. Do you prefer living in a big city or a small town?
roleplay.goal: 用 I prefer 开头表态，并用 because 给出一个具体理由

chapters.name: 第二章 · Task 3 校园话题

lessons.name: 2-1 概括学生态度
lessons.scene: Task 3：阅读一篇学校通知，再听学生对话，你需要概括学生的态度。
lessons.target_sentence: The student disagrees with the new policy for two main reasons.

knowledge_points.title: disagrees with
knowledge_points.explanation: 「不同意…」，Task 3 概括学生态度的标准动词，比 doesn't like 更正式。
knowledge_points.example: The student disagrees with the university's decision.

knowledge_points.title: for two main reasons
knowledge_points.explanation: 「出于两个主要原因」，预告结构，暗示接下来会分两点展开，逻辑性强。
knowledge_points.example: She supports the proposal for two main reasons.

exercises.question: 学生支持新政策，有两个理由，你怎么概括？
exercises.reference_answer: The student agrees with the new policy for two main reasons.

roleplay.setting: Task 3 准备 30 秒后开始作答。
roleplay.opening_line: Please speak now. Summarize the student's opinion and explain their reasons.
roleplay.goal: 明确学生态度（支持/反对），并用 for two main reasons 预告结构

chapters.name: 第三章 · Task 4 学术讲座

lessons.name: 3-1 用教授的例子说明概念
lessons.scene: Task 4：教授讲了一个心理学概念，并举了一个例子，你需要把概念和例子联系起来。
lessons.target_sentence: The professor uses an example of children learning to share to illustrate this concept.

knowledge_points.title: uses an example of
knowledge_points.explanation: 「用…的例子」，Task 4 把教授例子和概念连接的标准句型。
knowledge_points.example: The professor uses an example of a startup company to explain the theory.

knowledge_points.title: to illustrate this concept
knowledge_points.explanation: 「来说明这个概念」，illustrate 比 explain 更学术，体现对讲座结构的理解。
knowledge_points.example: She gives an example to illustrate this principle.

exercises.question: 教授用蜜蜂采蜜的例子来说明这个概念，怎么说？
exercises.reference_answer: The professor uses an example of bees collecting honey to illustrate this concept.

roleplay.setting: Task 4 准备 30 秒后开始作答。
roleplay.opening_line: Please speak now. Explain the concept and how the professor's example relates to it.
roleplay.goal: 用 uses an example of 连接教授的例子和概念

courses.name: 托福写作综合与独立
courses.description: 覆盖托福写作综合任务（总结讲座反驳阅读）与独立写作开头，掌握 3 个高分句型。

chapters.name: 第一章 · 综合写作总结

lessons.name: 1-1 讲座反驳阅读观点
lessons.scene: 综合写作：阅读说恐龙是冷血动物，讲座反驳说恐龙是温血动物，你需要总结这个反驳。
lessons.target_sentence: The lecture challenges the reading's claim by arguing that dinosaurs were actually warm-blooded.

knowledge_points.title: challenges the reading's claim
knowledge_points.explanation: 「质疑阅读的观点」，综合写作总结讲座与阅读矛盾的标准表达，比 disagrees 更有力。
knowledge_points.example: The lecture challenges the reading's claim about the origin of the painting.

knowledge_points.title: by arguing that
knowledge_points.explanation: 「通过论证…」，引出讲座的具体论据，体现因果逻辑。
knowledge_points.example: The professor refutes the idea by arguing that the data is unreliable.

exercises.question: 讲座通过论证数据有误来质疑阅读的观点，怎么写？
exercises.reference_answer: The lecture challenges the reading's claim by arguing that the data is inaccurate.

roleplay.setting: 老师让你用一句话总结讲座和阅读的关系。
roleplay.opening_line: In one sentence, how does the lecture relate to the reading passage?
roleplay.goal: 用 challenges 表达讲座反驳阅读，并通过 by arguing that 给出论据方向

chapters.name: 第二章 · 综合写作分点

lessons.name: 2-1 第一点反驳
lessons.scene: 综合写作主体第一段，你需要展开讲座反驳阅读的第一个论点。
lessons.target_sentence: First, the professor points out that the evidence cited in the reading is outdated.

knowledge_points.title: points out that
knowledge_points.explanation: 「指出…」，引出讲座具体论点的常用动词，比 says 更正式。
knowledge_points.example: The professor points out that the study has methodological flaws.

knowledge_points.title: the evidence cited in the reading
knowledge_points.explanation: 「阅读中引用的证据」，cited 表示「引用的」，精准定位阅读材料的内容。
knowledge_points.example: The data cited in the reading was collected decades ago.

exercises.question: 教授指出阅读中引用的数据不可靠，怎么写？
exercises.reference_answer: First, the professor points out that the data cited in the reading is unreliable.

roleplay.setting: 老师让你写综合写作的第一个反驳点。
roleplay.opening_line: Now write the first body paragraph. How does the lecture challenge the first point?
roleplay.goal: 用 First 开头，用 points out 引出教授对阅读第一点的反驳

chapters.name: 第三章 · 独立写作开头

lessons.name: 3-1 引出话题并表态
lessons.scene: 独立写作题目：「科技是否让人们更依赖他人？」你需要写一个开头段引出话题并表态。
lessons.target_sentence: In today's increasingly connected world, the question of whether technology makes people more dependent is widely debated.

knowledge_points.title: In today's increasingly ... world
knowledge_points.explanation: 「在当今日益…的世界」，独立写作引出话题的万能背景句，比 Nowadays 更有层次感。
knowledge_points.example: In today's fast-paced world, time management is more important than ever.

knowledge_points.title: is widely debated
knowledge_points.explanation: 「被广泛讨论」，被动语态引出争议话题，体现客观性。
knowledge_points.example: The issue of climate change is widely debated among scientists.

exercises.question: 你想写「在当今竞争激烈的世界，教育是否公平被广泛讨论」，怎么写？
exercises.reference_answer: In today's increasingly competitive world, the question of whether education is fair is widely debated.

roleplay.setting: 老师让你写独立写作的开头背景句。
roleplay.opening_line: Start your essay with a background sentence that frames the topic.
roleplay.goal: 用 In today's ... world 引出话题背景，并用 is widely debated 点出争议

courses.name: 商务会议实用英语
courses.description: 覆盖会议开场、表达观点、总结决策三大环节，掌握 3 个职场高频句型。

lessons.name: 1-1 宣布会议开始
lessons.scene: 你主持周一团队例会，需要宣布会议开始并说明议程。
lessons.target_sentence: Let's get started. First on the agenda is the Q3 sales report.

knowledge_points.title: Let's get started
knowledge_points.explanation: 「我们开始吧」，会议开场最自然的表达，比 Let's begin 更口语化。
knowledge_points.example: Let's get started since everyone is here.

knowledge_points.title: on the agenda
knowledge_points.explanation: 「在议程上」，agenda 是会议议程，on the agenda 表示待讨论的事项。
knowledge_points.example: The budget review is next on the agenda.

exercises.question: 你想宣布开始，并说第一项议程是项目进度更新，怎么说？
exercises.reference_answer: Let's get started. First on the agenda is the project update.

roleplay.setting: 会议室里同事们陆续到齐，你准备开始会议。
roleplay.opening_line: Good morning, everyone. Thanks for joining today's meeting.
roleplay.goal: 宣布会议开始，并说明第一项议程

lessons.name: 2-1 提出建议
lessons.scene: 会议上讨论市场推广方案，你想提出一个不同的建议。
lessons.target_sentence: From my perspective, we should focus more on social media marketing.

knowledge_points.title: From my perspective
knowledge_points.explanation: 「在我看来」，比 I think 更正式、更客观，商务会议表达观点的首选。
knowledge_points.example: From my perspective, this investment is too risky.

knowledge_points.title: we should focus more on
knowledge_points.explanation: 「我们应该更专注于…」，提出方向建议的标准句型。
knowledge_points.example: We should focus more on customer retention.

exercises.question: 你觉得团队应该更注重产品质量，怎么用商务方式表达？
exercises.reference_answer: From my perspective, we should focus more on product quality.

roleplay.setting: 讨论中有人提出了方案 A，你想补充建议。
roleplay.opening_line: So that's my idea. Does anyone else have thoughts on this?
roleplay.goal: 用 From my perspective 开头，提出一个明确的建议方向

lessons.name: 3-1 确认行动项
lessons.scene: 会议接近尾声，你需要总结讨论结果并分配下一步任务。
lessons.target_sentence: To sum up, we've agreed to launch the pilot next month. John, could you handle the logistics?

knowledge_points.title: To sum up
knowledge_points.explanation: 「总而言之」，会议结尾总结决策的标准短语，也可用 In summary。
knowledge_points.example: To sum up, we need to cut costs by 10% this quarter.

knowledge_points.title: we've agreed to
knowledge_points.explanation: 「我们已同意…」，现在完成时表示已达成共识，明确会议成果。
knowledge_points.example: We've agreed to extend the deadline by two weeks.

exercises.question: 你想总结「我们已同意下季度增加预算」，怎么说？
exercises.reference_answer: To sum up, we've agreed to increase the budget next quarter.

roleplay.setting: 讨论结束，你需要收尾并明确下一步。
roleplay.opening_line: I think we've covered everything. Let's wrap up.
roleplay.goal: 用 To sum up 总结决策，并指定一项行动项的负责人

courses.name: 商务邮件写作
courses.description: 覆盖邮件开场、提出请求、礼貌收尾三大要素，掌握 3 个地道商务邮件句型。

lessons.name: 1-1 说明邮件目的
lessons.scene: 你给客户写邮件，需要在开头说明这封邮件的目的。
lessons.target_sentence: I'm writing to follow up on our meeting last Tuesday regarding the contract.

knowledge_points.title: I'm writing to
knowledge_points.explanation: 「我写信是为了…」，商务邮件开头第一句的标准句型，开门见山。
knowledge_points.example: I'm writing to request a quotation for the new project.

knowledge_points.title: follow up on
knowledge_points.explanation: 「跟进…」，表示对之前讨论的事进行后续沟通，商务高频短语。
knowledge_points.example: I'd like to follow up on the proposal I sent last week.

exercises.question: 你想写邮件跟进上周的报价单，开头怎么写？
exercises.reference_answer: I'm writing to follow up on the quotation I sent last week.

roleplay.setting: 你给客户写跟进邮件，模拟客户回复的对话。
roleplay.opening_line: Hi there, thanks for reaching out. What can I do for you?
roleplay.goal: 用 I'm writing to 说明邮件目的，并提及之前的沟通

lessons.name: 2-1 请求对方提供信息
lessons.scene: 你需要请对方提供一些文件，在邮件中礼貌地提出请求。
lessons.target_sentence: Could you please send me the updated report at your earliest convenience?

knowledge_points.title: Could you please
knowledge_points.explanation: 「能否请你…」，比 Can you 更礼貌，商务邮件请求的标准开头。
knowledge_points.example: Could you please review the attached document?

knowledge_points.title: at your earliest convenience
knowledge_points.explanation: 「在你方便时尽快」，委婉表达「尽快」，比 ASAP 更礼貌得体。
knowledge_points.example: Please reply at your earliest convenience.

exercises.question: 你想请对方尽快提供合同草稿，怎么礼貌地写？
exercises.reference_answer: Could you please send me the draft contract at your earliest convenience?

roleplay.setting: 你在邮件中向同事请求一份资料，对方回复确认。
roleplay.opening_line: Sure, I can help with that. What exactly do you need?
roleplay.goal: 用 Could you please 提出请求，并礼貌地说明时限

lessons.name: 3-1 期待对方回复
lessons.scene: 邮件正文写完，你需要礼貌收尾并期待对方回复。
lessons.target_sentence: I look forward to hearing from you soon. Best regards, Li Ming.

knowledge_points.title: I look forward to hearing from you
knowledge_points.explanation: 「期待你的回复」，商务邮件最经典的收尾句，to 后接动名词。
knowledge_points.example: I look forward to your response at your earliest convenience.

knowledge_points.title: Best regards
knowledge_points.explanation: 「祝好」，商务邮件最通用的结尾敬语，正式但不生硬。
knowledge_points.example: Best regards, [Your Name]

exercises.question: 邮件结尾你想表达「期待尽快收到你的回复」，怎么写？
exercises.reference_answer: I look forward to hearing from you soon. Best regards, Li Ming.

roleplay.setting: 你写完邮件收尾，模拟客户确认收到。
roleplay.opening_line: Thanks for the update. I'll get back to you shortly.
roleplay.goal: 用 I look forward to 收尾，并使用 Best regards 敬语

courses.name: 议论文核心结构
courses.description: 掌握议论文开头引入、主体论证、结尾总结三大结构，写出逻辑清晰的英文短文。

lessons.name: 1-1 引出话题背景
lessons.scene: 写一篇关于「在线学习是否优于课堂学习」的议论文，你需要用一个背景句开头。
lessons.target_sentence: With the rapid development of technology, online learning has become increasingly popular in recent years.

knowledge_points.title: With the rapid development of
knowledge_points.explanation: 「随着…的快速发展」，议论文引出时代背景的万能开头，让文章有大格局。
knowledge_points.example: With the rapid development of artificial intelligence, many jobs are changing.

knowledge_points.title: has become increasingly popular
knowledge_points.explanation: 「变得越来越流行」，现在完成时 + increasingly 描述趋势，比 more and more 更正式。
knowledge_points.example: Remote work has become increasingly common since the pandemic.

exercises.question: 你想写「随着社交媒体的发展，短视频越来越流行」，怎么写开头？
exercises.reference_answer: With the rapid development of social media, short videos have become increasingly popular.

roleplay.setting: 老师让你写议论文开头的背景句。
roleplay.opening_line: Give me a strong opening sentence that sets the context for this essay.
roleplay.goal: 用 With the development of 引出背景，并用 increasingly 描述趋势

lessons.name: 2-1 给出论据支撑
lessons.scene: 议论文主体段，你需要提出一个论点并用理由或例子来支撑。
lessons.target_sentence: One key advantage is that online learning allows students to study at their own pace.

knowledge_points.title: One key advantage is that
knowledge_points.explanation: 「一个关键优势是…」，主体段提出论点的标准句型，结构清晰。
knowledge_points.example: One key advantage is that renewable energy reduces pollution.

knowledge_points.title: at one's own pace
knowledge_points.explanation: 「按自己的节奏」，地道短语，描述个性化学习的优势。
knowledge_points.example: Self-paced courses let you learn at your own pace.

exercises.question: 你想说「在线学习的一个优势是可以随时随地学习」，怎么写？
exercises.reference_answer: One key advantage is that online learning allows students to study anytime and anywhere.

roleplay.setting: 老师让你写议论文的一个主体段论点。
roleplay.opening_line: Now state your first argument clearly with a supporting reason.
roleplay.goal: 用 One key advantage is that 提出论点，并补充一个具体支撑

lessons.name: 3-1 重申观点并升华
lessons.scene: 议论文结尾，你需要重申立场并给出展望或建议。
lessons.target_sentence: In conclusion, while online learning offers great flexibility, traditional classrooms remain irreplaceable.

knowledge_points.title: In conclusion
knowledge_points.explanation: 「总之」，议论文结尾最标准的标志词，比 To sum up 更书面。
knowledge_points.example: In conclusion, both methods have their merits.

knowledge_points.title: while A ..., B ...
knowledge_points.explanation: 「虽然 A…，但 B…」，结尾段平衡表达观点的经典让步结构，体现思辨能力。
knowledge_points.example: While technology brings convenience, it also raises privacy concerns.

exercises.question: 你想结尾「总之，虽然城市化带来便利，但也带来环境问题」，怎么写？
exercises.reference_answer: In conclusion, while urbanization brings convenience, it also causes environmental problems.

roleplay.setting: 老师让你写议论文的结尾段。
roleplay.opening_line: Wrap up your essay with a balanced conclusion.
roleplay.goal: 用 In conclusion 开头，用 while 让步结构平衡地重申观点

courses.name: 四级听力短对话
courses.description: 覆盖四级听力短对话高频场景：选课、借书、约会，掌握 3 个听懂言外之意的关键句型。

lessons.name: 1-1 课程太满了
lessons.scene: 四级听力短对话：两个学生讨论选课，女生说她这学期课太多了。
lessons.target_sentence: I'm taking five courses this semester, and I'm already feeling overwhelmed.

knowledge_points.title: I'm taking + 课程
knowledge_points.explanation: 「我选了…课」，take a course 表示选课，四级听力高频表达。
knowledge_points.example: I'm taking an advanced English course this semester.

knowledge_points.title: feeling overwhelmed
knowledge_points.explanation: 「感到不堪重负」，暗示课太多忙不过来，态度题常考的隐含信息。
knowledge_points.example: With all these deadlines, I'm feeling overwhelmed.

exercises.question: 你想说「我这学期选了四门课，已经感觉忙不过来」，怎么说？
exercises.reference_answer: I'm taking four courses this semester, and I'm already feeling overwhelmed.

roleplay.setting: 走廊里遇到同学，聊起这学期的选课。
roleplay.opening_line: Hey, how's your semester going so far?
roleplay.goal: 说明你选了几门课，并表达是否感到压力

lessons.name: 2-1 书被借走了
lessons.scene: 四级听力短对话：学生去图书馆借书，被告知书已被借走。
lessons.target_sentence: I'm sorry, but that book has been checked out. It's due back next Friday.

knowledge_points.title: has been checked out
knowledge_points.explanation: 「已被借出」，被动语态，图书馆表示书不在馆内的标准说法。
knowledge_points.example: The novel you want has been checked out.

knowledge_points.title: due back
knowledge_points.explanation: 「到期归还」，due 表示「到期的」，图书馆说明归还日期的常用词。
knowledge_points.example: The book is due back on the 15th.

exercises.question: 你想说「那本书已经被借走了，下周三到期归还」，怎么说？
exercises.reference_answer: That book has been checked out. It's due back next Wednesday.

roleplay.setting: 你在图书馆前台查一本书，管理员查询后告知结果。
roleplay.opening_line: Let me check the system for you. What's the title?
roleplay.goal: 听懂书已借出，并询问归还日期

lessons.name: 3-1 改期见面
lessons.scene: 四级听力短对话：男生约女生周末看电影，女生说有事想改时间。
lessons.target_sentence: I'm afraid I can't make it this Saturday. Could we reschedule for next week?

knowledge_points.title: I can't make it
knowledge_points.explanation: 「我来不了」，委婉拒绝邀约的地道表达，比 I can't come 更自然。
knowledge_points.example: I can't make it to the party tonight.

knowledge_points.title: reschedule
knowledge_points.explanation: 「重新安排」，改时间的正式说法，日常和商务都通用。
knowledge_points.example: Let's reschedule the meeting to Thursday.

exercises.question: 你想说「这周我来不了，能改到下周吗」，怎么说？
exercises.reference_answer: I'm afraid I can't make it this week. Could we reschedule for next week?

roleplay.setting: 朋友约你周末一起出去，你有事想改时间。
roleplay.opening_line: Hey, are you free this Saturday? I was thinking we could catch a movie.
roleplay.goal: 委婉表示无法赴约，并提出改期建议

courses.name: 六级翻译核心技巧
courses.description: 覆盖六级翻译三大难点：无主句处理、长句拆分、文化词汇转换，掌握 3 个实用翻译句型。

chapters.name: 第一章 · 无主句处理

lessons.name: 1-1 增补主语
lessons.scene: 六级翻译真题：「要控制空气污染，需要政府和个人共同努力。」中文无主句，翻译时需补主语。
lessons.target_sentence: To control air pollution, we need the joint efforts of the government and individuals.

knowledge_points.title: To + 动词原形 表目的
knowledge_points.explanation: 「为了…」，把中文目的状语前置，用 To do 开头，六级翻译常用手段。
knowledge_points.example: To improve efficiency, we adopted new technology.

knowledge_points.title: we need + 名词
knowledge_points.explanation: 「我们需要…」，为无主句增补主语 we，让英语句子结构完整。
knowledge_points.example: To solve this problem, we need a comprehensive approach.

exercises.question: 翻译「要解决这个问题，我们需要采取有效措施」，怎么译？
exercises.reference_answer: To solve this problem, we need to take effective measures.

roleplay.setting: 老师让你翻译一句中文无主句。
roleplay.opening_line: Translate this sentence: 要提高英语水平，需要每天坚持练习。
roleplay.goal: 用 To do 开头表目的，并用 we need 增补主语

lessons.name: 2-1 用分词短语拆分
lessons.scene: 六级翻译：「中国是世界上人口最多的国家，拥有五千年的灿烂文明。」一句话含两层信息，需拆分。
lessons.target_sentence: China, the most populous country in the world, boasts a splendid civilization of 5,000 years.

knowledge_points.title: 同位语插入
knowledge_points.explanation: 用同位语（the most populous country）补充说明主语，把中文的并列结构变成英语的主从结构。
knowledge_points.example: Beijing, the capital of China, is a historic city.

knowledge_points.title: boasts
knowledge_points.explanation: 「拥有（引以为豪的事物）」，比 has 更生动，翻译「拥有」时的加分动词。
knowledge_points.example: The city boasts a long history of over 2,000 years.

exercises.question: 翻译「长城是中国的象征，拥有两千多年的历史」，怎么译？
exercises.reference_answer: The Great Wall, a symbol of China, boasts a history of over 2,000 years.

roleplay.setting: 老师让你把一个长中文句翻译成流畅的英文。
roleplay.opening_line: Translate: 故宫是明清两代的皇宫，位于北京中心。
roleplay.goal: 用同位语结构整合两层信息，并用 boasts 替代 has

chapters.name: 第三章 · 文化词汇转换

lessons.name: 3-1 翻译文化专有名词
lessons.scene: 六级翻译：「春节是中国最重要的传统节日，家人团聚吃年夜饭。」涉及文化词汇。
lessons.target_sentence: The Spring Festival is the most important traditional holiday in China, when families gather for a reunion dinner.

knowledge_points.title: The Spring Festival
knowledge_points.explanation: 「春节」的标准译法，比 Chinese New Year 更正式，六级翻译文化词首选。
knowledge_points.example: The Spring Festival falls on the first day of the lunar calendar.

knowledge_points.title: when 引导定语从句
knowledge_points.explanation: 「在那时…」，把中文「家人团聚」处理为修饰节日的定语从句，避免流水句。
knowledge_points.example: Mid-Autumn Festival is a time when families admire the full moon together.

exercises.question: 翻译「中秋节是中国传统节日，家人团聚赏月」，怎么译？
exercises.reference_answer: The Mid-Autumn Festival is a traditional Chinese holiday when families gather to admire the moon.

roleplay.setting: 老师让你翻译一句含中国文化词汇的中文。
roleplay.opening_line: Translate: 端午节是为了纪念诗人屈原，人们吃粽子赛龙舟。
roleplay.goal: 准确翻译文化专有名词，并用 when 从句整合团聚场景
